features.name: Project Setup & Verification Baseline
features.description: Confirm the project installs dependencies, runs verification (lint/test/build), and starts from a clean checkout.

features.name: Dashboard with Inactive Client Alerts (7–10 days)
features.description: PT sees a dashboard listing clients and a prominent alert if a client has had no sessions in the last 7–10 days.

features.name: Client Management (Add, Edit, Delete)
features.description: PT can add a new client, edit client information, and remove a client from the list.

features.name: Workout & Session Schedule
features.description: PT can create a workout session for a client and view upcoming sessions in a schedule.

features.name: InBody Progress Tracking
features.description: PT can enter InBody metrics for a client and view progress history or a simple chart over time.

features.name: Interaction Notes
features.description: PT can add text notes to a client to record conversations or important reminders.

features.name: Smart Slot Availability & 1-Click Zalo Rescheduling
features.description: PT can check which standard daily slots are free or booked for today and tomorrow, then reschedule a client in one click with a ready-to-paste Zalo confirmation message.
